select cls,
  case when fished_date_doy < 230 then 'pre230' else 'post230' end as period,
  sum(yt) as yt, sum(anglers) as anglers,
  round(sum(yt)/sum(anglers),3) as rate
from trips
where fished_date_season=1
group by 1,2
order by 1,2

select cls, sum(anglers) as anglers_by_d98, round(sum(yt)/sum(anglers),3) as rate_by_d98
from trips
where fished_date_season=1 and fished_date_doy <= 98
group by 1 order by 1

select fished_date_doy, sum(anglers) over (order by fished_date_doy) as cum_anglers,
 sum(yt) over (order by fished_date_doy) as cum_yt
from (select fished_date_doy, sum(anglers) anglers, sum(yt) yt from trips
where fished_date_season=1 and cls in ('hd_pm','hd_unspecified') and fished_date_doy<=100
group by 1) t
order by fished_date_doy
